suggestions.rationale: Question tests proper net asset classification of underwater endowments under UPMIFA, which is fundamental to preparing a statement of financial position correctly.
Tests interfund reimbursement elimination mechanics in consolidation, not measurement focus/basis recall or fund determination.
Directly tests determination of appropriate fund type (internal service vs enterprise fund classification).
Tests GASB 68 pension accounting mechanics and deferred outflow treatment, not measurement focus/basis or fund determination.
Tests net position classification mechanics (restricted vs committed vs assigned), not measurement focus/basis or fund determination.
Tests operating vs nonoperating expense classification for lease components in proprietary funds, not measurement focus/basis or fund determination.
Tests application of modified accrual revenue recognition, but Task 1 is about recalling which basis is used, not applying it.
Tests GASB 65 bond issuance cost treatment across fund types, not measurement focus/basis recall or fund determination.
Tests special item classification on government-wide statements, not measurement focus/basis or fund determination.
Tests GASB 54 fund balance spending order mechanics with formal policy override, not measurement focus/basis or fund determination.
Tests grant classification (operating/nonoperating/capital) in proprietary fund statements, not measurement focus/basis or fund determination.
Question tests capital asset depreciation rules under GASB 34, not measurement focus or basis of accounting recall, nor fund determination.
Question tests definition of custodial credit risk under GASB 40 disclosure standards, not measurement focus/basis or fund determination.
Question tests BANs reporting treatment within a fund (fund liability vs long-term debt), not which fund to use for an activity.
Question tests landfill closure liability calculation under GASB 18, not measurement focus/basis or fund determination.
Question tests application of modified accrual to RAN transactions, not recall of what measurement focus/basis of accounting are, nor fund determination.
Question tests evaluation of internal service fund premium reasonableness under GASB 10, not measurement focus/basis or fund determination.
Question tests net position classification under GASB 46, not measurement focus/basis recall or fund determination.
Question tests identification of public entity risk pools under GASB 10, not measurement focus/basis or fund determination.
Question tests in-substance defeasance reporting under GASB 86, not measurement focus/basis or fund determination.
Question tests accounting change treatment under GASB 62, not measurement focus/basis or fund determination.
Question tests recall of historical terminology (OCBOA vs SPF), not financial statement titles or preparation methods covered by any listed task.
Question tests conceptual understanding of measurement bases (NRV vs. fair value), not preparation/adjustment/correction of financial statements.
Question tests knowledge of presentation rules for extraordinary items, not preparation/adjustment of income statement from source data.

Question tests analysis of agency vs. contribution classification under ASC 958-605, requiring evaluation of variance power and discretion—higher-order reasoning not covered by the mechanical statement preparation tasks (all L1-L2).
Question directly tests calculation and understanding of interest expense for bonds issued at a premium using the effective interest method, which exactly matches the task description.
Residual value determination is a prerequisite component for calculating amortization of finite-lived intangible assets, which falls under Task 2's scope.
Question tests classification knowledge essential to preparing a statement of cash flows.
Question tests how to report a sale-leaseback transaction amount, directly required for preparing a statement of cash flows.
Question tests classification of escrow deposits, fundamental to preparing a statement of cash flows.
